tools.useSummary: Turns compatible nuts and bolts with adjustable smooth jaws.
tools.neutralDescription: A hand tool with a movable jaw and an open head.
tools.fullDescription: An adjustable wrench has smooth jaws whose opening changes to fit compatible nuts and bolts.

tools.useSummary: Grips and turns pipe and round fittings with serrated jaws.
tools.neutralDescription: A long-handled hand tool with an adjustable angled jaw assembly.
tools.fullDescription: A pipe wrench uses serrated angled jaws to grip and turn round pipe and fittings.

tools.useSummary: Turns matching nuts and bolts with a fixed-size open or box end.
tools.neutralDescription: A fixed-size hand tool with an open, enclosed, or combination end.
tools.fullDescription: A combination, open-end, or box wrench turns nuts and bolts that match its fixed size.

tools.useSummary: Grips and turns varied objects within the tool's limits.
tools.neutralDescription: A hinged gripping tool with a pivot that can move between positions.
tools.fullDescription: Slip-joint pliers change jaw opening at the sliding pivot and grip varied objects within their limits.

questions.prompt: Which tool is designed to grip and turn round pipe and fittings?

rationales.message: An adjustable wrench turns nuts and bolts with smooth jaws; it is not the purpose-built choice for round pipe.
A combination wrench matches nuts and bolts rather than gripping round pipe.
Correct. A pipe wrench has serrated jaws designed to grip and turn round pipe and fittings.
Slip-joint pliers can grip varied objects within their limits, but the pipe wrench is the tool designed for this task.

questions.prompt: Which tool uses adjustable smooth jaws to turn compatible nuts and bolts?

rationales.message: A pipe wrench has serrated jaws for gripping round pipe and fittings, not smooth jaws for compatible nuts and bolts.
Slip-joint pliers grip varied objects within their limits, but they are not the smooth-jaw adjustable wrench described.
Correct. An adjustable wrench uses adjustable smooth jaws to turn compatible nuts and bolts.
A combination wrench turns matching nuts and bolts with fixed-size ends rather than adjustable jaws.
